text: 加纳央行行长约翰逊·阿西亚马24日表示，加纳将与中国合作，推动在两国贸易交易中取消使用第三方货币结算。阿西亚马在当日晚间举行的货币政策委员会新闻发布会上表示，贸易商希望充分利用中国对53个非洲建交国全面实施零关税举措，这一关键性的转变对加强加中双边贸易至关重要。阿西亚马透露，加纳正在建立加纳塞地与人民币之间的跨币种结算通道，以消除第三方货币带来的双重汇兑和额外手续费。央行已批准标准银行加纳子行——斯坦比克银行和加纳最大本土银行加纳商业银行开展加中直接跨币种结算系统的试点项目。他表示，加纳央行计划在即将举行的国际货币基金组织和世界银行年会上与中国人民银行就
text_en: Bank of Ghana Governor Johnson Asiama said on the 24th that Ghana will cooperate with China to promote the elimination of third-party currency settlement in trade transactions between the two countries. Speaking at a news conference of the Monetary Policy Committee held that evening, Asiama said traders want to make full use of China's zero-tariff measure fully implemented for 53 African countries with diplomatic ties, and this key shift is crucial to strengthening bilateral trade between Ghana and China. Asiama disclosed that Ghana is establishing a cross-currency settlement channel between the Ghanaian cedi and the renminbi to eliminate the double foreign-exchange conversion and extra handling fees caused by third-party currencies. The central bank has approved Standard Bank's Ghana subsidiary, Stanbic Bank, and Ghana Commercial Bank, Ghana's largest domestic bank, to carry out a pilot project for a direct Ghana-China cross-currency settlement system.
